name: Docusaurus
description: Docusaurus is a React-based static site generator from Meta for documentation sites and blogs, with MDX support.
notes: Version 3.10.2. Blog-only setup: docs plugin off, blog at /posts with a bare Layout override (no navbar/footer), prev/next overridden to null, tags cleared via processBlogPosts (no tag pages), built-in list page emptied, and a small local plugin feeding the index page.
